summary.value: Motion ordering submitted to the voters at the November 4, 2014 election an ordinance raising the San Francisco minimum wage to $12.25 per hour on May 1, 2015, with annual increases reaching $15.00 per hour in 2018, followed by annual cost-of-living increases.

citations.quote: Motion ordering submitted to the voters an ordinance amending the Administrative Code to increase the minimum wage for employees in San Francisco to $12.25 per hour on May 1, 2015, with annual increases, reaching $15.00 per hour in 2018, followed thereafter by annual cost-of-living increases
at an election to be held on November 4, 2014.

title.value: Initiative Ordinance - Administrative Code - Minimum Wage
